note: Flux-averaged total cross section for coherent NC single-pi0 production (nu A -> nu A pi0), NuMI low-energy neutrino-mode beam (numu-dominated), MINOS Near Detector (Fe:C 80:20 medium). Flux-integrated sigma only, no differential binning tabulated (angular/Evis distributions are figures only). Target: per nucleus (A=48 Fe:C 80:20 average medium; A=56 iron-inferred; A=12 carbon-inferred, all "per nucleus" not per nucleon). No covariance is published (per-bin total uncertainty only).
